doc: The @cue vocabulary of .dlg files (docs/kb/tech/dialogue_format.md). tools/dlgc.py rejects unknown cues, unknown key= arguments, and values outside these types and option sets. Arg types: id (letters, digits, _), number, int, bool, string, emotion (game/data/dialogue/emotions.json), enum (values, or a named set). Positional args are listed in order; optional ones come last. one_of: exactly one of these names must be given. requires: key -> the name it needs. reserved: cue -> first-arg values that are commands rather than ids, each a meaning string or {doc, kwargs: [the only keys allowed with it]}.

music.silence: Not a track: fade the music bed out to nothing (fade= sets the time).

release.doc: Not a shot: hand the camera back to the field volumes (FieldCameraDirector.release). Without blend= it blends with the volume's resolved blend; blend=0 cuts; a force_hard_cut volume always cuts.

camera.doc: Cut (no blend=, or blend=0) or blend to an authored shot. ease= names a field_camera.json ease for this blend (sets.camera_eases mirrors them). grade= also blends the color grade to that color-script frame. 'release' is reserved (see reserved.camera).

anim.doc: Play a body animation, optionally aimed at a target (actor, mark, or prop).

mark.doc: Move an actor to a scene mark: in a straight line, or along the via marks (comma-separated, in order) as one eased walk turning at each corner.

face.doc: Override the facial expression over sec seconds (otherwise lines' [emotion] drives it).

music.doc: Change the music bed. 'silence' is reserved (see reserved.music). stem= brings that stem of the cue in over the fade (the cue carries on if it is already playing).

sfx.doc: Play a one-shot sound. vol is a linear gain (1.0 = as authored); at= places it on an actor or mark.

light.doc: M2-FP-102: turn a practical light on the stage (a Light3D found by node name, e.g. Rhen's LanternLight) on or off, easing its energy over sec (0 or none = at once). On restores the energy it was authored with.

vfx.doc: Trigger a VFX. Glimmer light rules: glimmer_lift rises (motion=spiral_up), glimmer_held sinks (drift=down_seaward), glimmer_bound is still. The cue goes first to the stage's VFX hosts (CutsceneVfxHosts, M3-ARC-1326), then to the motes placeholder. follow=<actor> or <actor>_staff: one attractor on that body; anchors=<actor group>: grief anchors that let go as the follow-host passes (hosts read them; the placeholder ignores them).

wait.doc: Pause the sequence for sec seconds, until the music reaches marker (music=), or until an actor's current @mark walk lands (arrive=; at once when it is not walking). max= is the sequencer's fallback timeout for a music wait.
